instruction: Clean studio photograph, full shot. In a minimalist indoor studio with a beige wall and white floor, three young gymnasts pose. On the left, the dark-haired girl (R1) in a beige long-sleeve top and shorts holds her leg in a vertical split. On the right, the dark-haired girl (R6) in a matching beige outfit holds her leg in a vertical split. In the center foreground, the blonde girl (R5) in a beige long-sleeve top and shorts holds a backbend bridge pose, tilting her head to look at the camera. Soft, diffused natural light illuminates the warm, neutral-toned scene.
